exercises.sentence: Con el aumento de la especulación inmobiliaria, encontrar apartamento en el centro _____ muy difícil para los jóvenes.
exercises.english: With rising property speculation, finding an apartment in the centre has become very difficult for young people.

exercises.sentence: El plan no busca frenar el turismo, _____ que pretende proteger la vivienda asequible.
exercises.english: The plan does not seek to curb tourism, but rather aims to protect affordable housing.

exercises.sentence: En cuanto _____ en vigor la reforma de zonificación, se ampliará la vivienda social.
exercises.english: As soon as the zoning reform comes into force, social housing will be expanded.

exercises.sentence: Apenas se inauguró la línea de metro, se encareció el suelo urbano en todo el distrito.
options: As soon as the metro line opened, urban land became more expensive across the whole district.
As soon as the metro line closed, urban land became more expensive across the whole district.
As soon as the metro line opened, urban land became cheaper across the whole district.

exercises.sentence: No se trata de impulsar la expansión urbana, sino de mejorar la movilidad urbana.
exercises.english: It is not a matter of promoting urban sprawl, but of improving urban mobility.

template.prompt: Write one sentence saying that after the price rise, two streets were left depopulated, using «tras la subida de precios», «dos calles» and «se quedaron despobladas».
template.answer: Tras la subida de precios, dos calles se quedaron despobladas.

template.prompt: Write one sentence saying that paying the rent in the centre has become unsustainable, using «pagar el alquiler» and «se ha hecho insostenible».
template.answer: Pagar el alquiler en el centro se ha hecho insostenible.
